content.text: Skip to Main ContentALL DEFINITIONSLoose Bodies in the ElbowDefinitionLoose bodies in the elbow are small fragments of bone or cartilage that have become detached and are floating within the elbow joint. These fragments can cause pain, swelling, and limited range of motion, and may result from injury, degenerative joint disease, or other underlying conditions.Related SpecialistsLisa LattanzaMDHand Surgery, Orthopaedics & Rehabilitation, Shoulder and Elbow Orthopedic Surgery, Pediatric Orthopedics We use cookies and similar technologies to make our site work.
